verified.exploit_entry_point: the packages/clickhouse public API: createQueryBuilder({adapter: createClickHouseAdapter({client})}) -> table().select().where()/withCTE()/orderBy()/groupBy()/limit()/having() -> toSQL()/execute(), plus the packages/datasets MetricExecutor over that factory. The hidden suites drive those entry points with a recording ClickHouse client, so no server is needed, and judge the generated statement by decoding its string literals, comparing its token skeleton with a benign-input baseline, and evaluating its WHERE/HAVING clause over in-memory rows.
sites: packages/serve/src/semantic/datasets/utils/filtered-aggregation-sql.ts:16-37 (second copy of the renderer; fixed by the reference, not exercised by the hidden suites)
routes: T1: string filter values through where()/toSQL()/execute() and the adapter render path, including a trailing backslash, a backslash before a quote, and a first value that ends with a backslash next to a second value carrying the payload
T2: object and array values through the same where() path (JSON branch of escapeValue)
T5: expr.or/expr.and groups, raw fragments carrying a top-level AND/OR, and multiple HAVING fragments in one statement; fragments ending inside -- / # line comments
T8/T9/T17: function names, withCTE aliases, order-by and group-by columns, table names and row limits supplied at run time
T11: a measure definition's filter value compiled by MetricExecutor into the aggregation expression
verified.project_tests_run: cd packages/clickhouse && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run -> 346 passed at the pinned commit; cd packages/datasets && ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run -> 64 passed. After the reference fix the clickhouse suite has 3 failures, all exact-SQL expectations that the published fix itself updated (query-builder.where.test.ts function-predicate grouping); the graded functional suite asserts the equivalent semantics instead of that text.
verified.recall_patch: checks/upstream_fix.patch is the two published fixes ported onto the pinned tree: upstream's own core/utils.ts and core/utils/sql-parens.ts from 2879161a (backslash-aware escapeValue, the positional-parameter scanner, null/date hard-fails), the same predicate-builder/formatter group and comment handling as the reference, and the fn-name and CTE-alias validation the published fix added. It deliberately omits the column/limit/table checks and the datasets/serve literal renderer, which no published fix touched.
verified.control: tasks/stk-hypequery-9256-control: same report (byte-identical instruction.md), same functional suite, security suite reduced to the advisory's own route (the bound-string encoder); its reference is the published one-line backslash fix. Local runs: oracle 37/37, nop 6 security failures and 31 functional passes.
